summary: Updates a cursor scroll/drag center to new input coordinates, clamps the center within viewport bounds, and writes both normalized deltas (current center minus previous center, scaled) and normalized clamped positions into the tracker's float fields. Reads viewport bounds at this+0x0/0x4/0x8/0xC and per-axis scaling factors at this+0x18/0x1C. Returns the maximum Y bound stored at this+0x4.

Write the normalized clamped Y to this+0x2C (dword index 11): the clamped center Y at this+0x14 multiplied by the Y scale at this+0x1C.
Return the maximum Y bound read from this+0x4 (dword index 1).
